simplesounds.option.globalLevel.tooltip:
Own intensity when following is disabled or
Simple Visuals is unavailable.
Off/Subtle/Normal/Strong/Maximum:
0/0.35/0.6/0.8/1 gain. Default: SUBTLE.
simplesounds.option.volumeCap.tooltip:
Hard limit 0–0.25; Vanilla ambient slider
also applies. Default: 0.25.
simplesounds.option.soundsPerPlayer.tool:
0–2; only your player is observed. Default:
1.
simplesounds.option.cooldownTicks.toolti:
20–1200 ticks per effect/player; mapping
intervals also apply. Default: 40.
simplesounds.option.footstep_dust.toolti:
Local Vanilla sound
minecraft:block.powder_snow.step; at least 20
ticks apart and never sooner than the effect
cooldown, base volume 0.05, pitch 1.35–1.45.
Default: INHERIT.
simplesounds.option.cold_breath.tooltip:

cooldown, base volume 0.06, pitch 0.85–0.95.
Default: INHERIT.

simplesounds.title: Simple Sounds
simplesounds.option.followVisuals.toolti:
Use the Simple Visuals intensity when
available. Effect overrides take priority;
otherwise your own level applies. Client
only. Default: true.
